correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the precise two source axioms with all quantifiers. M1 implies active suffix and coordinatewise monotone output path. M2 forces top terminal pair, rules out two non-top coordinates at first active output through incomparable upper cone pairs, and forces all intermediate values of remaining coordinate. The converse verifies M1 and M2 for each explicit normal form, including empty and singleton suffixes. Disjoint orientation count and commutative/total special cases checked. The standalone enumerator exhausts every row-partial function for n=1..4, finds no divergence between raw axioms and normal forms, verifies exact subclass counts. The unbounded proof, not the test, warrants correctness.

value.rationale: Deterministic ternary semantics are a natural tractable restriction when probing two-input intuitionistic modalities. The theorem identifies a structural obstruction: under both required persistence clauses a function from source worlds to ordered target pairs is never genuinely two-dimensional on a finite chain. It gives the full classification and uniform exact counts, including the total and commutative subcases; this is more than a small enumeration or a renaming of unary-frame results. Scope is explicit; no broader completeness or algorithm is claimed.
